purpose: All 21 distinct eligible CT20 initial prescriptions for subsequent design-space exploration; no overall winner

aperture_fit.policy: Coupled mode: equal front/back radius, capped by smaller original face. Independent mode: each face capped by its own original radius. aperture_fit.limitation: Sampled nonnegative Y fields in a rotationally symmetric system. No rigorous extremum proof between fields/rings/azimuths and no manufacturing tolerance allocation. Dense downstream qualification remains necessary.
aperture_fit.mechanical_profile: Only clear semi-diameters are specified. Mechanical outer diameter, edge/chamfer or tapered solid profile is unspecified; independent clear faces are not manufacturing certification.
